# External data (not on KAPSARC)

| File | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `saudi_cpi_monthly.csv` | GASTAT CPI tables, March 2026 release: https://www.stats.gov.sa/documents/d/guest/cpi-tables-mar-2026-ar-en-1- (sheets 5.1–5.3) | 2023=100, COICOP 2018, Jan 2024 – Mar 2026. GASTAT moved to this methodology in Aug 2025; earlier months are the back-cast series. |
| `gold_monthly.csv` | World Bank Pink Sheet (CMO monthly, to Dec 2025) and datahub `gold-prices` (Jan–Mar 2026) | Monthly average, USD per troy ounce (LBMA-based; the two sources agree within ~$0.5). |
